84bffbf0cd6c87c1648134c2d8dc6e12.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Letter of Congratulations to National Symphony Orchestra on Its 80th Founding Anniversary
paragraphs: Pyongyang, August 8 (KCNA) -- Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a letter of congratulations to the creative workers and artistes of the National Symphony Orchestra on Saturday, its 80th founding anniversary.
The full text of his letter is as follows:

I, in the name of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and the government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, extend warm congratulations and greetings of encouragement to the creative workers and artistes of the National Symphony Orchestra on greeting its 80th founding anniversary with a sense of honour and pride in having glorified its brilliant history together with our beloved motherland.

Quite extraordinary are the remembrances of the history of the meaningful Moranbong Theatre and of the National Symphony Orchestra that have aroused emotions among the people with the solemn and characteristic sounds of the works of mixed orchestra of our own style.

Having proclaimed its birth as the first orchestra of a new Korea on August 8, 1946 with the playing of "Song of General Kim Il Sung", it powerfully demonstrated the ideological will and strong aspiration of all the people to achieve civilization and prosperity with a soaring spirit and mettle for nation building; it has injected renewed vitality and vigour into social progress with model masterpieces of the times. These are etched in the pages of our history.

In the days when the country was experiencing harsh trials, the creative workers and artistes of the orchestra willingly followed the arduous road and rendered support to the revolution with the musical instruments as a weapon of struggle. In the decades that seethed with creation and construction, they proudly sang of the worthwhile life of the people who were shaping a rosy future with affection for their socialist country. In this way, they offered great encouragement to the progress of our cause. These feats of theirs are never trifling.

From the first days of its founding, it has portrayed the songs of praise of our Party and socialism as orchestral works and symphonic suites and medleys, thus presenting them as monumental masterpieces. Its creative activities constitute patriotic feats that recorded in history by dint of solemn and fresh sounds the victorious course our glorious Republic has traversed.

The general title of the works the orchestra has portrayed and put on stage over the past 80 years, sharing the history of our people's struggle to accomplish the gigantic social transformations under the leadership of the Party, should be called "Symphony of Socialism" on its own terms.

In the stirring decade when an era of overall efflorescence of Juche-oriented art was being ushered in, it re-presented such masterpieces as "A Bumper Harvest in the Chongsan Plain", "The Dear Home in My Native Village", "The Girl on the Swing" and "Arirang", pioneering a new realm of symphony of our own style and bringing home to the people the unusual might of music that leads them to share the destiny of their country and promotes its development. Our people still remember vividly these creative activities of the orchestra.

It can be said that every work represents the language of faith and conscience and the melody of love and passion, which can be expressed only by the musicians of Korea who regard our Party's ideas on aesthetics and musical theories as the only ideology and banner for their creation and by true artistes who treasure everything beautiful on this land and are determined to sing of it to the last moment of their lives.

Comrades Ho Jae Bok, Kim Pyong Hwa, Choe Ki Hyok and other talented conductors and instrumentalists of the orchestra made a contribution to cultivating the rich flower garden of the Juche-oriented art with unflagging passion. Their images still remain implanted in the eyes of our people, and serve as a model of worthwhile life of the revolutionary men of art and literature who sang of their motherland throughout their lives.

The ennobling aspirations and painstaking efforts of the creative workers and artistes of the orchestra to add lustre to its fine history and traditions with innovative achievements can be clearly seen in the fact that they are demonstrating the might of the Juche-oriented symphony in the present era of transformation by arranging famous musical works, loved by the people, to suit the works' emotional contents and modern aesthetic tastes.

In recent years alone, they have created a large number of refined works and gave splendid concerts in celebration of major national holidays, boosting the ennobling feelings of patriotism cherished deeply in the hearts of our people and giving a strong impetus to their spiritual and cultural growth. Their performing activities have left an indelible impression on the people for their peculiar features and moods.

The orchestra has always preserved its competent creative guidance forces and skilled instrumentalists and kept creating symphonies of various themes while successfully re-presenting historical works. These add more to the proud history of the authoritative orchestra.

I think this is an expression and outcome of their true and devoted attitude and outlook on life to support the Party and the country with performing activities, not out of mere sense of duty or with artistic skills, but out of a desire to remain faithful to their jobs assigned by their country without expecting any reward or honour.

Such an excellent spiritual world, with which they are invariably and faithfully fulfilling their duty and steadily writing the history of the orchestra by dint of ennobling consciousness and pure conscience, is the most precious one beyond compare.

Over the past eight decades the orchestra has faithfully preserved its original features of patriotic enthusiasm and sincere artistic creation in their pure forms, exalting its prestige and honour as befitting a national-level art institution that carries on the history of development of Juche-oriented music. It is a precious treasure of our state and a source of great pride for our Party and our people.

Throughout those long years, the creative workers and artistes of the orchestra have remained loyal to its initial aim and basic mission, thereby enjoying the affection and trust of their country and fellow people, and strove to maintain their proud reputation and traditions with constant renovations and progress. For this, I highly appreciate all of them.
Creative workers and artistes of the National Symphony Orchestra,
The art of music has been a powerful engine for the development of our state, and it will be so, in the future, too.
Our Party's consistent principle in musical creation is to ensure high ideological and artistic qualities, sustain the characteristics of the times and apply a people-oriented approach to the letter.

You should, just as you have done so far, accept the Party's policies on art and literature as absolute and work only as intended by the Party; firmly united in ideology and purpose and also in feeling and emotion, you should work hard to usher in a golden age of the art of music in the new era.
Melodies have a peculiar attraction of greatly stirring up a person's ideological feelings and drawing them into an emotional world that is inexpressibly rich and profound.

As creative workers and instrumentalists of the orchestra, which is in effect a national icon, you ought to excel in artistic insight and skills, and also stand in the vanguard in creating masterpieces that are representative of our era.

Our Party hopes that you will steadily improve your abilities to create and stage any work in a flawless and perfect way, thus continuing to add brilliance to your orchestra's prestige and honour befitting the best music group in our country that boasts a long history and traditions.

Today, when we are advancing towards greater transformation, enthusiastically singing revolutionary songs and other musical works as a march for our struggle and creation, a masterpiece pulsating with the spirit of the times will serve as an invaluable spiritual sustenance.

I firmly believe that all of you, creative workers and artistes of the orchestra, always mindful of the Party's and people's trust and expectations, will continue to write the pages of honourable history of Juche-oriented symphony by improving your practical abilities and conducting proactive and enterprising activities for artistic creation.
I pay tribute to the National Symphony Orchestra's glorious 80-year-long history. -0-

c3a1db555b8bed2d801925e8df39a78d.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Has Photos Taken with Creative Workers and Artistes of National Symphony Orchestra Greeting Its 80th Founding Anniversary
paragraphs: Pyongyang, August 9 (KCNA) -- Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on August 8 met and congratulated the creative workers and artistes of the National Symphony Orchestra on its 80th founding anniversary.

All the creative workers and artistes of the orchestra were filled with great excitement and joy as they came to realize their greatest desire to have Comrade Kim Jong Un, for whom they yearned so much, at their theatre on the significant founding anniversary.

Comrade Kim Jong Un was courteously greeted at the Moranbong Theatre by officials of the Central Committee of the WPK, Hyon Un Chol, minister of Culture of the DPRK, and leading officials of the National Symphony Orchestra.
When he entered the main lobby of the theatre, the excitement of creative workers and artistes greeting the moment of greatest happiness developed into thunderous cheers.

Comrade Kim Jong Un warmly congratulated all the creative workers and artistes of the National Symphony Orchestra significantly commemorating its founding anniversary with the glory and pride of having made the brilliant history with the beloved country, and had a photo session with them.

He presented a bouquet of congratulation to Ho Mun Yong, a conductor who was honored with Kim Il Sung Prize, and had photos taken with the creative workers and artistes who were honored with high-class state commendations amid the pride of having contributed to the development of Juche-oriented symphony.

All the creative workers and artistes broke into stormy cheers and chanted slogans of loyalty in reflection of their firm resolution to continue to write the pages of honorable development history of Juche-oriented symphony by conducting proactive and enterprising activities for artistic creation, bearing deep in mind the love and trust of the benevolent Marshal Kim Jong Un who sent a letter of congratulations to the orchestra greeting its 80th founding anniversary and repeatedly showed great benevolence.

Comrade Kim Jong Un appreciated that it is the high pride of our Party, state and people to have such an art group with an excellent history and tradition and high creative ability as the National Symphony Orchestra, which has cultivated the flower garden of Juche-oriented musical art, enthusiastically singing revolutionary songs and other musical works as a march for struggle and creation in the development course of our Republic.

The authoritative National Symphony Orchestra should play a role as an engine in developing the musical art, which is as ever strong motivating power for prosperity of our state, he said, adding that when the solemn and characteristic sounds of the works of our own style orchestra give greater impetus to the Korean revolution and lead the heyday of development of the musical art in the new era, our cause will emerge victorious with greater strength and full vitality.

Very high is our Party and people's expectation in the orchestra which has faithfully preserved its original features of patriotic enthusiasm and sincere artistic creation in their pure forms over the past eight decades, he said, and gave precious instructions to be adhered to as a guideline by the orchestra to exalt its prestige and august name as befitting an artistic group of national value that carries on the history of development of Juche-oriented music. -0-

6178b143e252a7b8141697ead20c5fe7.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Liberation Tower on Occasion of 81st Anniversary of National Liberation
paragraphs: Pyongyang, August 15 (KCNA) -- Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Friday visited the Liberation Tower on the occasion of the 81st anniversary of national liberation.
Accompanying him were senior officials of the WPK Central Committee and leading officials of the Foreign Ministry and the Ministry of National Defence of the DPRK.
The Korean People's Army guard of honor lined up before the Liberation Tower.
The national anthems of the Russian Federation and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea were played.
A wreath in the name of Comrade Kim Jong Un was laid amid the playing of wreath-laying music.
Written on the ribbon of the wreath were the letters reading "We will not forget the feats of the martyrs of the Soviet Army".
Comrade Kim Jong Un paid high tribute to the martyrs of the Soviet Army who bravely fought for the liberation war of our people for freedom and independence of the country.
He looked round the Liberation Tower with those officials.

Looking back with deep emotion on the militant feats of the officers and men of the Red Army who dedicated their hot blood to the sacred cause of Korea's liberation, he said that even after the lapse of time and even though one generation may be replaced by another, the DPRK people will always remember the noble soul the martyrs put into this land and the heroic, self-sacrificing spirit displayed by them.

The excellent history, traditions and ties of blood between the DPRK and Russia now serve as a fundamental cornerstone and inexhaustible driving force for the bilateral relations of friendship and cooperation, he said, stating that the great friendship and unity between the two peoples forged with the noble idea and genuine militant friendship would be steadily carried forward and developed generation after generation along with the new era of comprehensive efflorescence. -0-

eb00cb03de41ca9aa76dcbaa7f7d6b5d.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Monuments to Pay Tribute to Anti-Japanese Revolutionary Martyrs on National Liberation Day
paragraphs: Pyongyang, August 15 (KCNA) -- Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Friday visited the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong on the occasion of the 81st anniversary of national liberation.

Present there were senior Party, government and military officials, including members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, and leading officials of the WPK Central Committee, the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, the Cabinet, commissions, ministries and national agencies and commanding officers of the Korean People's Army.
The KPA guard of honor lined up there.
The national anthem of the DPRK was played.
A wreath in the name of Comrade Kim Jong Un was placed at the wreath-laying stand of the cemetery amid the playing of wreath-laying music.
Also, laid were wreaths in the name of the WPK Central Committee, the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, the DPRK SPA Standing Committee and the DPRK Cabinet.

Comrade Kim Jong Un, together with all the participants, paid a silent tribute to the memory of the revolutionary martyrs who devoted their precious lives to the sacred struggle for the independence and sovereignty of the country and its prosperity.
There took place a march-past of the KPA guard of honor.

Noting that the revolutionaries of the first generation fought a bloody war of resistance to save the country and the nation and retake the dignity with their minds burned with the noble sense of duty to bear the responsibility for the destiny of the country and descendants, Comrade Kim Jong Un said that their steadfast independent spirit and undying feats are ideological and moral treasure and precious revolutionary legacy to be inherited for all ages.

The anti-Japanese revolutionary fighters' beautiful ideal of communism, transparent revolutionary faith and indomitable fighting spirit are injecting eternal viability into our people in their struggle to build a prosperous powerful country the martyrs desired, he said, stating that the cause of the great Korean people will be ever-victorious as they are carrying forward the high revolutionary spirit and noble view of life generation after generation.
Then he visited the Monument to Fallen Anti-Japanese Revolutionary Fighters.

With reverence for the well-known and unsung anti-Japanese revolutionary martyrs, who made a contribution to accomplishing the historic cause of national liberation, remaining faithful to the ideology and leadership of President Kim Il Sung, he placed a flower at the monument and observed a moment's silence in memory of them.

Looking at a sculpture of three members of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army fighting a heroic battle and a stone monument bearing many martyrs' names, he said that although the bodies of the martyrs who dedicated their precious youth to the revolution to retake the dignity and freedom of the country and the people were buried in unknown mountains and fields, their proud images and feats are clearly recorded in the history of the country.

He hoped that the pioneering generation of the Korean revolution, who created the priceless revolutionary traditions of Paektu and handed them down to the new generations, would be always remembered at the peak of the highest honor and dignity along with the advance and development of the ever-victorious socialism of our own style. -0-

75391ce3ae2c8a75fb1e742ae020413f.title: Sports Events Held to Mark 81st Anniversary of National Liberation
paragraphs: Pyongyang, August 17 (KCNA) -- A swimming and diving contest took place on August 16 under the schedule of sports cultural events marking the National Liberation Day.
Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, enjoyed the contest.
All the participants were filled with great excitement and joy as they came to significantly celebrate the National Liberation Day with sports cultural events in the presence of Comrade Kim Jong Un.
When Comrade Kim Jong Un appeared in the natatorium, all the players and spectators raised stormy cheers of "Hurrah!"

Among the spectators were leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs, officials of the WPK Central Committee, the Cabinet, ministries and national agencies and commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence.

A swimming contest was held by six teams, divided into men's 100 meter freestyle and 100 meter breaststroke, women's 100 meter freestyle and 100 meter breaststroke, and 4×400 meter mixed medley relay in which each of four swimmers in a team uses backstroke, freestyle, breaststroke and butterfly stroke for each 100 meters.
The contest was so close amid the enthusiastic cheers of the audience.
And a diving contest was held by three teams, divided into men and women's individual 10 meter platform diving and mixed 10 meter synchronized platform.
In the swimming contest, the Sobaeksu Sports Team came first, the Ministry of Fisheries Sports Club second and the Suyangsan Sports Club third.
The Sobaeksu Sports Team came first in total standings of the diving contest.
Then, followed a synchronized swimming demonstration.
An awarding ceremony was held amid the applause of the participants.
The sports cultural event for celebrating the 81st anniversary of national liberation revved up the festive mood of the August 15 holiday. -0-

b49d81959591f3ff511d538224427505.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Enjoys Circus of National Acrobatic Troupe Celebrating 81st Anniversary of National Liberation
paragraphs: Pyongyang, August 17 (KCNA) -- A circus of the National Acrobatic Troupe celebrating the 81st anniversary of national liberation was given at the Pyongyang Circus Theatre on August 16, amid joy and excitement of the people in the DPRK greeting the significant day when their great motherland newly emerged with pride.
Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, enjoyed the performance.
When Comrade Kim Jong Un appeared in the auditorium amid the playing of welcome music, the participants raised stormy cheers of "Hurrah!"

On the occasion of the 81st anniversary of national liberation, Comrade Kim Jong Un extended warm congratulations to all the people and the servicepersons who are creating a new era of comprehensive development with boundless love for their precious and sacred country and confidence and optimism about their cause.

Among the audience were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and other senior Party and government officials, children of anti-Japanese revolutionary martyrs and anti-Japanese patriotic martyrs, teaching staff and students of revolutionary schools, officials of ministries and national agencies and armed forces organs, and officials and labor innovators of industrial establishments and youth and students in Pyongyang.
The national anthem of the DPRK was played.
Put on the stage were colorful numbers including physical acrobatics "Wire-rope Walking" and "Fly Higher" which won top prizes at international circus festivals.

The elegant folk acrobatic works and refined numbers of high technique, full of deep emotion and vibrant vitality, showed well the appearance of the DPRK's acrobatic art blooming and developing day by day.
The peculiar pieces given by a juggler familiar with the people made the audience imbued with the world of mysterious jugglery.
The performance was acclaimed by the audience as it drew out excitement, admiration and cheerful laughter.
Expressing great satisfaction over the acrobats' successful performance, Comrade Kim Jong Un warmly congratulated them.
He met creative workers, artistes and officials of the National Acrobatic Troupe who added to joy and optimism on the National Liberation Day through their excellent performance.

Saying that the troupe is an authoritative art organization as it has glorified the honor and prestige of the country while being loved by the people through creation of world-famous acrobatic works and active performance activities for over 70 years, he highly appreciated the merits of the creative workers and artistes of the troupe who have contributed to the development of socialist culture with influence peculiar to the acrobatic art.

Expressing belief and expectation that the creative workers and artistes of the troupe would create and perform more excellent acrobatic pieces, welcomed by the times and the people, by giving full play to their extraordinary creative talents, high skill and patriotic enthusiasm and thus usher in a new heyday of development of the acrobatic art, he had a photo taken with them. -0-

517f9931a76c1cd348ce49220d055479.title: Fourth Enlarged Meeting of Political Bureau of Ninth Central Committee of WPK Held
paragraphs: Pyongyang, August 26 (KCNA) -- The Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea convened its fourth enlarged meeting on August 25 to take more political and practical measures for guaranteeing the successful implementation of the major policy tasks for 2026, the first year for implementing the new Five-Year Plan set forth by the historic Ninth Congress of the Party.

Present there were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, and members and alternate members of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK. Present as observers were vice-premiers of the Cabinet, major ministers, commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence and senior officials of relevant departments of the C.C., WPK.
Comrade Kim Jong Un guided the meeting.

The Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee first heard a report on the progress made in this year's major policy-oriented projects, adopted and assigned by the first and second plenary meetings of the Ninth Central Committee of the Party, and on the current situation of major economic sectors.

The Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee positively appreciated the important changes and successes demonstrating the transition to a new phase of development, being made in overall state work from the first year of implementing the decisions of the Party Congress.

The enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau underlined the need to set a clear goal and orientation of the struggle and secure a scientific and efficient guarantee for bringing about certain attainment, now that the valuable successes, achieved by strenuous efforts, are being accumulated and the plans, greater than the past, are being worked out.

The enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau recalled the character and significance of this year's struggle, which is crucial for successfully attaining the gigantic long-term goals set forth by the Party Congress, and stressed the need for the Cabinet, the State Planning Commission and other economic guidance organs and the policy-oriented guidance departments of the Party Central Committee to display extraordinary responsibility and high prudence.

The Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee examined the strategic coordination and timely measures for successful completion of the projects planned for this year and strengthened capability for implementing short-, intermediate- and long-term tasks on the principle of encouraging successes and experience, constantly drawing lessons and securing solutions in conformity with the characteristics of the times and the requirements of the reality, in which a creative struggle, unprecedented in terms of the width and depth of state development and the gigantic nature of its long-term goals, is underway.

The enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau specified the principles and a series of policies for the state economic guidance organs to prudently and strategically tide over the unfavorable conditions and difficulties arising alongside ever-changing circumstances, and ensure concentration in the construction of major policy-oriented objects, in particular.

Pointing out a series of deviations revealed in the course of implementing the decisions of the Party Congress, Comrade Kim Jong Un said that they are the consequences of the immature operation and leadership of the economic guidance organs failing to keep abreast of our greater ideals and progress and such shortcomings can be overcome and eliminated by the efforts redoubled with a new determination and struggle will.

Noting that the important duty to steer all sectors of socialist construction to fresh innovations and changes and eye-opening rate of growth has been placed on the shoulders of the leading cadres, he called upon all the Party organizations to more dynamically conduct their organizational and political work to give full play to the spiritual strength of the masses as required by the invariable policy of the Party Central Committee on giving priority to ideological work in every undertaking.

Saying that the on-going advance requires extraordinary courage and strenuous efforts beyond precedents and limits, he noted that the goals of transformations set forth by the Ninth Party Central Committee are not merely the numbers in practical plans but important political tasks for preserving the dignity of the country and proving the superiority of the social system.

He stressed the need for the officials responsible for the implementation of the Party decisions to successfully conclude this year's struggle without fail and thus pave a broad avenue to attaining the new long-term goals, always mindful that the current daily successes, symbolic of the on-going accelerated advance and development, will just lead to the promotion of the people's wellbeing. -0-

c027895599feaa33489c9de697974a3a.title: Second Meeting of Ninth WPK Central Military Commission Held
paragraphs: Pyongyang, August 30 (KCNA) -- The Second Meeting of the Ninth Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea was held on August 29.

Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, Chairman of the Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, guided the meeting.
Present at the meeting were members of the WPK Central Military Commission.

The meeting heard the appraisal of the recent political and military activities of the Korean People's Army Committee of the WPK and the Ministry of National Defence of the DPRK and discussed a series of structural reorganization plans for the improvement and development of the future overall defence affairs.
The meeting discussed the organizational matter.

The Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee approved by-election of Pak Jong Chon, advisor to the Ministry of National Defence of the DPRK, as a member of the WPK Central Committee and a member of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, Yu Kwang U, director of the Security Bureau of the Korean People's Army, as a member of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, and Om Ju Ho, political commissar of the KPA Air Force, as a member of the WPK Central Committee.

The WPK Central Military Commission decided as follows after deliberating the change of position of the military commanding officers for key posts and receiving ratification of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee:
Pak Jong Chon, advisor to the Ministry of National Defence of the DPRK, was by-elected as vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the WPK.

No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, was dismissed and recalled from the Party central leadership and appointed as first vice-director of the Munitions Industry Department of the WPK Central Committee.
Kim Song Gi, director of the General Political Bureau of the Korean People's Army, was appointed as minister of National Defence of the DPRK.

Yu Kwang U, director of the Security Bureau of the Korean People's Army, was appointed as first vice-director of the General Political Bureau of the KPA, and Om Ju Ho, political commissar of the KPA Air Force, as director of the Security Bureau of the KPA.

The WPK Central Military Commission expressed expectation and conviction that the major commanding officers starting their work in the new posts would firmly arm themselves with the Party's idea of building a strong army and responsibly fulfill their role through boundless devotion and extraordinarily high activity in implementing the Party's military lines and policies. -0-

ee19f508d8fde4eb8e86551bad36baf9.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Awards State Commendation to Distinguished Contributors to Bolstering Up Defence Capabilities
paragraphs: Pyongyang, August 30 (KCNA) -- Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met and congratulated the scientists, researchers and officials of major defence research institutions, who made a great contribution to resolving scientific and technological problems of epochal significance in developing new combat weapon systems and improving their performance and to putting the military and technical strength of national armed forces on a higher level, at the headquarters of the Party Central Committee on August 29.
Present there were Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, and Kim Jong Sik, first vice department director of the Central Committee of the WPK.

True to the policy of modernizing the armed forces set forth at the historic Ninth Congress of the Party, the defence science research sector has recently developed exclusive technologies, to be regarded as an event in strengthening the capability for fighting a war and the deterrence, thus fully demonstrating again the course of unique development of the country's military and technological capabilities.

Comrade Kim Jong Un read out a decree of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK on awarding state commendations to those who made distinguished contributions to bolstering up the defence capabilities, and personally conferred the title of DPRK Hero and Gold Star Medal and Order of National Flag First Class and Order of Kim Il Sung on a scientist, researcher and official.

Highly appreciating the recent exclusive innovative military sci-tech achievements, made and introduced in the defence science research field, as a great revolution that opened up a sure prospect for radically improving the modernity of our army's combat weapon systems, Comrade Kim Jong Un paid high tribute on behalf of the DPRK government to the national defence science research group for its boundless efforts, patriotic devotion and heroic contribution.

The defence scientists displaying boundless loyalty to the Party and the revolution, the country and its people and unlimited creativity to guarantee the strength and prestige of our state with matchless sci-tech power are the greatest patriots and heroes, he said, stating that our Republic is invariably preserving the high prestige and glory of invincibility thanks to the great role of the defence science research group who has always perfectly implemented the military strategic policies of the Party Central Committee.

Expressing expectation and belief that the excellent defence scientist research group would bolster up the arms of the self-defensive power in a more overwhelming and stronger manner for the great state and people, he had a photo session with them.

The defence scientists, researchers and officials, given the highest honor by the country and its people, pledged to remain true to the sacred responsibility and duty they have assumed before the Party and the revolution by further striving to attain the higher goals of strengthening the national defence capability, faithfully upholding the far-reaching intentions of Comrade Kim Jong Un with single-minded unity and loyalty. -0-
